descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: re-send snapshot.

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S19 Send, then change a task and send again: two records, the first unchanged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Each send leaves the same record as Handoff: sender, recipient and timestamp, persistent and retrievable on both sides (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • T2 The recipient opens the received list from their own account, read-only; the tasks do not become the recipient's own tasks (TFA-92585 AC 6; TFA-92585 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Sender has sent the S01 list (Hospital) and the S02 list (Nursing Home) to the recipient once each

When Sender ticks 'Order PT evaluation' done and sends the Hospital list again; ticks 'Wound check with nursing' done and sends the Nursing Home list again; recipient opens all four records, reloads, opens the older ones again

Then Two records per context on each side, each with its own time; each first record still shows the later-ticked task as pending, each second record as completed; both survive a reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U8 (each send is its own record) and the Handoff rule that the recipient receives the text as sent (TFA-92586 AC 4). Record counts from handoffs:list after the run (4 task-list rows from {sender}; oracleRules 6). Same-patient pairs only (Q5): second Hospital record ['Follow up blood cultures', 'Order PT evaluation'] (Ben pending before Ben completed), second Nursing Home recor …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
